native_generation_prompt:
Static factual editorial illustration for a published article; one original textbook mechanism illustration on pure white. Final composition 1200 × 630, wide 1.905:1. If the native frame is taller, place the whole scene centrally within that aspect ratio with generous pure-white extra thickness above and below for a center crop. Leave 72 px or more white at all four edges within the final crop including artwork and text. One coherent illustration, no multi-image panels.
Orthographic layered storyboard with staggered transparent media leaves rendered in plum and saffron gouache editorial diagram, crisp contours and matte layers.
Supported mechanism: Adobe announced a preview of locally running integrations that work inside native project files. The article describes editing with project layers and ongoing human refinement; availability differs by feature.
Region 1: A blank campaign brief with one colored motif marked by a physical cutout. Region 2: An upright set of editable picture, timeline and layout leaves; arrow ends on the nearest leaf edge. Region 3: A carefully fanned set of still-separate editable strata, no flattened export or automatic release. Use all those distinct semantically meaningful elements, without artificial scenery or filler.
Use precisely one clearly directed arrow at y=320, from the illustrated left object edge to the center intake object edge. Both ends must touch the named physical objects. Never touch text or imply paths from any other object. Keep the remaining relationship legible from aligned physical layout, with no further arrows.
The ONLY visible writing anywhere is these exact four labels, in order: "Campaign edit", "Native files", "Editable layers", "Integration preview". Crisp heavy newsroom sans lettering, large enough at 320px, above the corresponding objects inside the labeled boxes. Put the fourth label centered in a clear band below the objects with white padding. No existing UI, faux text strokes, numbers, badges, generic control knobs, photorealistic gloss, logos or human figures.
No claim that every integration is generally available. No cloud transfer, branded controls or unattended approval.
Use matte layered transparencies, no copied UI, brand marks, decorative controls, or availability marks.
